entry.name: windowed-fft~
entry.description: windowed-fft~ is an abstraction wrapping a pair of fft~ objects and performing the necessary windowing and overlap to use the output for analysis.

arguments.name: number-of-FFT-samples
arguments.description: The first argument specifies the number of points (samples) in the FFT. It must be a power of two. If you are unsure, use 1024.
